definitions.definition: Constitutional/doctrinal authority over PH6 architecture. Does not itself constitute Lane-1 measurement evidence.
Deterministic evidentiary authority operating inside the authoritative measurement/disposition path.
Authority zero. May observe, verify, reason, map, report, recommend and record advisory state within permitted boundaries. May not issue or modify authoritative PASS/DROP dispositions.
Authoritative PSEUDO-A disposition defined by governing PH6 doctrine. Not an AI confidence judgment.
Authoritative PSEUDO-A disposition defined by governing PH6 doctrine. Not an AI rejection or refusal.
An advisory/protocol disposition indicating that a requested operation was not performed because a governing constraint prohibited it. REFUSAL is not DROP.
Explicit representation that available closed vocabulary or evidence cannot adequately encode/resolve the encountered condition. IOU is not PASS, DROP, failure, or permission.
The independently computed digest equals the expected digest under the declared hash algorithm and byte representation.
The independently computed digest does not equal the expected digest. One differing byte is sufficient.
Evidence that bytes/representation correspond to an expected identity. Integrity does not establish semantic truth.
A bounded check against specified evidence, schema, registry, enum, hash, invariant or test condition.
Evidence that specified checks/tests were satisfied under their declared scope. Validation does not automatically constitute certification.
A distinct governed determination under the applicable PH6 certification contract. An AUTH:0 agent cannot self-promote verification into certification.
A resolvable reference identifying evidence supporting a record (source path + digest).
A mutation of governed or persistent system state.
The operation produced no mutation of the governed target state.
A condition in which valid encountered events cannot be represented by the closed vocabulary at an acceptable rate. Distinct from individual unmapped events.
Departure from an established PH6 contract, vocabulary, authority boundary, schema or invariant.
The governing failure disposition for prohibited architectural drift, where PH6 doctrine specifies it. An advisory agent must not invent new conditions that produce DRIFT_FAIL.

note: Read-only control-plane dictionary for the suited agent. 'I know what this PH6 word means' must never become 'therefore this meaning is canonical' — definition_status carries that distinction. Broader PH6 terms (CRAM, PSEUDO-M/A, MRAM-S, TOK, etc.) are deliberately deferred: some have historical/evolving meanings and source rules prohibit silently reconciling them.
purpose: PH6 Definition Registry — 'What does this PH6 term mean?' (knowledge/control-plane vocabulary). Distinct from the SoSo Suit Protocol Vocabulary — 'What may this particular agent say happened?' (runtime event vocabulary). Neither grants authority.
